verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, CaC availability, acquisition status, mechanics, and costs. Preserve unsupported unlock, stamina, probability, and Ultimate Finish fields as null.
research_scope: Gigantic Slam — Strike Super / unavailable-for-CaC classification research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Xenoverse 2 customization documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No duplicate research batch found; canonical identity is Super / Strike, with unavailable-for-CaC retained as a separate catalog characteristic.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Gigantic Slam as a Strike Super, a grab/slam attack, and explicitly states that it is unobtainable for CaC.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: No Future Warrior/CaC unlock route is documented. Broly and designated Broly custom-partner presets are the documented users; Partner Customization does not convert the move into a CaC skill.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because no Future Warrior acquisition route is established.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because reviewed sources do not establish a reliable canonical value.

records.name: Gigantic Slam
records.character_source: Broly / Broly (Supervillain) / Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) customizable partner
records.skill_description: A close-range grab Strike Super in which Broly seizes the opponent and slams them downward with a Ki Wave.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation describes a forward face grab followed by a downward slam and Ki Wave impact. The skill is categorized as a grab and 6-hit Strike Super, with an explicit warning that the user is left open afterward. Exact frame, hitbox, and universal damage values are not promoted as canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Gigantic Slam is unobtainable for the Future Warrior/CaC. Current documentation lists no unlock route. Broly and Broly custom-partner variants are the documented users; partner customization is a cast-character customization system and is not a CaC unlock.
records.pve_notes: Cast/partner-only skill; no CaC Parallel Quest, Skill Shop, mentor, or Shenron acquisition route established.
records.pvp_notes: Close-range grab with a Ki Wave follow-up; detailed matchup and frame behavior remains version-sensitive.
